# README header assets

Light and dark headers used at the top of the repository `README.md` (same pattern as Externa, Excubia and laravel-oidc).

Copied from the Signaculum brand kit (`projects/qiick/brand/signaculum/github/` social-preview assets) on **2026-11-16**. Do not redraw them; refresh from that kit when the brand files change.

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `header-light.svg` | `signaculum-social-preview-1280x640-light.svg` |
| `header-dark.svg` | `signaculum-social-preview-1280x640-dark.svg` |
| `header-light.png` | `signaculum-social-preview-1280x640-light.png` |
| `header-dark.png` | `signaculum-social-preview-1280x640-dark.png` |

Dimensions: 1280×640. The README uses a `<picture>` element with `prefers-color-scheme`.
